description: Supernet Technologies Limited is a Pakistani ICT company and a subsidiary of Telecard Limited, listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It supplies connectivity, security, power, IT infrastructure and software solutions to enterprises, telecom operators, government and defence customers. The Supernet business has operated since 1995, when it began as a dial-up internet service provider, and its engineering staff are present at more than 200 locations in Pakistan.
